description: Sharper replacement landscapes, four 2x2 sheets. Tile order follows era order, ending with Transcendence.

assets.prompt: Create a production game landscape atlas, exactly 2 columns by 2 rows, four equal square scenes with NO gutters, NO borders, NO text. Highest available resolution, target 4096x4096, each scene highly resolved for large game backgrounds. Use the reference era atlas for scene identity and the thinker atlas for crispness and style. Redraw only these four scenes in order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right: Curiosity: a campfire and solitary wanderer beneath a vast starry mountain lake sky; Animism: sacred ancient forest with luminous golden spirits among roots; Mythology: magnificent mountain temples above clouds at sunrise; Monotheism: glowing gothic cathedral on a cliff at night. Beautiful wondrous retro pixel art with extremely crisp square pixel edges, controlled color ramps, clean silhouettes and intricate architectural/landscape detail. No blurry brushwork, no depth-of-field blur, no soft atmospheric smear, no antialiasing, no film grain. Sharp like the reference portraits. Every tile a complete immersive scene. Keep scene center composition readable and important landmarks within center 70%. Preserve each scene's atmosphere and palette.
